title: Why you feel uneasy looking at realistic CGI people
hook: Why do realistic robots often feel so creepy?

narration.text: Your brain is incredibly sensitive to human faces and expressions.
When something looks almost human, but not quite, it triggers an alarm.
Our minds expect perfect human features, or clearly non-human ones.
That small imperfection suggests illness, danger, or something unnatural.
This mismatch between expectation and reality causes the unsettling feeling.
It is why early CGI characters often felt more disturbing than cartoons.
Comment with a robot that gives you the creeps, like if this surprised you, and subscribe for more brain insights.

description: Ever wondered why some highly realistic robots or CGI characters make you feel uneasy? It is not just you; it is a fascinating psychological phenomenon. This short explains the "uncanny valley" effect and why our brains react the way they do to near-human figures.
topic: Why you often feel a sense of unease or 'the uncanny valley' when looking at very realistic robots or CGI people.
